questions.text: No seu trabalho no lar em Leeds, que apoio deu a residentes da unidade de demência com demência ou outra condição prolongada?
questions.english: In your work at the care home in Leeds, what support did you give to residents in the dementia unit with dementia or another long-term condition?
questions.why: The form asks about knowledge of long term health and social care conditions; your confirmed notes mention working in a care home but not what you did with residents who have those conditions.

questions.text: O formulário pede “Awareness and understanding of how Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, Dignity & Respect, and Human Rights will apply to this role.”: o que escreveria?
questions.english: The form asks for "Awareness and understanding of how Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, Dignity & Respect, and Human Rights will apply to this role.": what would you write?
questions.why: The app asks this itself: the form wants it in your own words, and none of your confirmed facts says it in the first person.

answer.text: I have worked in a care home in Leeds for three years since October 2023 providing daily care and support to residents.
I knock on the door before entering, explain what I will do before personal hygiene and always close the curtains to protect dignity.
I respect each person's culture and religion and ask how they want to be addressed and treated, including what they want to eat and whether they prefer to be helped by a woman.
One night I saw a bruise on a resident's arm.
I recorded it and told the nurse on duty immediately.
I have moving and handling training and use the hoist.
We always work in pairs.
I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents.
Before each shift I read each resident's care plan and follow it.
At the end of the shift I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.
We as the whole team moved dinner earlier.
I made cards with photos of food so each person can point to what they want.
I did three years of nights and also weekends.

letter.text: Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,
I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.
I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023.
I read each resident's care plan before the shift and follow it.
I have moving and handling training and use the hoist.
I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents.
I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet at the end of the shift.
I knock on the door before entering as part of dignity.
Thank you for considering my application.
Yours sincerely, Ana
